tablet-clank.scope_model: qualification scope_key is explicit and gates are isolated per production or campaign source scope

shared_contract.authority_boundary: target-local execution boundary establishes provenance before qualification facts are written
shared_contract.material_identity: stable, explicit, scope-aware identity is computed before prior evidence is gated
shared_contract.reset_order: material-change reset is persisted before changed-run gate evaluation
shared_contract.reset_lineage: prior and new material identities plus reason, provenance, epoch, and execution linkage are retained
shared_contract.evidence_persistence: reset and terminal facts are distinct and terminal persistence is idempotent
shared_contract.gate_rule: gates consume current-scope/current-epoch evidence and never invent provenance; UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN and fails closed
shared_contract.migration_rule: target-local SQLite migrations are additive and preserve existing history, including unknown legacy provenance
